scrapers.name: AIOStreams
scrapers.description: Debrid-backed torrent streams from a configured AIOStreams instance, resolved from tmdbId via a TMDB external_ids lookup (AIOStreams itself is keyed on IMDb id). Replaces Torrentio, which this used to run. Authenticates with a UUID/password baked into providers/aiostreams.js. Retries once on a transient failure or empty result. Uses no timers and no AbortController: Nuvio's sandbox defines neither setTimeout nor a fetch that honours an AbortSignal, and getStreams swallowed the resulting throw into an empty result. Request deadlines are skipped where timers are unavailable. Listed first in this manifest so it's the first provider's results Nuvio shows when it resolves; each returned link is now probed for playability before being returned, cached (instantly playable) links are sorted ahead of uncached ones, and the list is capped at 2.
scrapers.author: Ported from the English Stremio addon's aiostreams.js

scrapers.name: Castle
scrapers.description: English movies and series scraped from Castle. Patched to require a strict (75% token-coverage) title match instead of a loose substring match that accepted wrong titles, and to allow single-word titles (that check previously rejected every 1-word title outright, e.g. Inception, Barbie). Also carries a pure-JS AES-CBC decrypt so it no longer crashes on Nuvio's missing crypto-js. Each returned link is now probed for playability before being returned, and the list is capped at 2, sorted by known resolution first.
scrapers.author: Vendored from All-in-One-Nuvio, via the English Stremio addon

scrapers.name: HDHub4u
scrapers.description: English/Hindi movies and series scraped from HDHub4u. Patched so its first-result fallback only fires when the candidate covers 75% of the query's title tokens, fixing wrong-title matches like "P.S. I Love You" for "I Love You Phillip Morris". Also carries a pure-JS AES-CBC decrypt so it no longer crashes on Nuvio's missing crypto-js (used by one of its extractors). Each returned link is now probed for playability before being returned, and the list is capped at 2, sorted by known resolution first.
